name: 吐纳剑诀
desc: 稳健出剑，附带小额吸气。
descEn: Steady swordplay with minor qi absorption.

name: 赤焰掌
desc: 爆发火劲，对敌造成高额伤害。
descEn: Explosive fire force dealing heavy damage.

name: 玄冰指
desc: 寒气侵体，压制敌人行动。
descEn: Freezing cold that suppresses enemy actions.

name: 雷煞斩
desc: 引雷入刃，强攻但耗灵更高。
descEn: Channels lightning into blade, powerful but costly.
